quarterly_data.quarter: SK Hynix IR presentation: Q1 2026 results (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 2026 results deck, market outlook: some signs of softening demand have emerged, including adjustments in set shipments and product portfolio changes, due to cost pressures from higher memory prices; robust server memory demand continues to offset this weakness and drive overall market growth; with demand for high-performance memory surging while supply remains constrained, the company expects a favorable pricing environment to continue for the time being.

quarterly_data.quarter: SK Hynix IR presentation: Q1 2026 results (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 2026 results deck, roadmap: for HBM4, SK Hynix works closely with customers from early development stages and plans to ramp up volume in line with the agreed schedule; it completed development of the industry's first 1cnm LPDDR6 (company claim), with full-scale market supply planned in the second half of 2026 starting with adoption in a major smartphone customer's next-generation flagship model.
